origin: Procedurally generated for HIKARI by Sources/GenerateStrokeTextures.py (pure Python, deterministic seed)
licenseClaim: No CC0 or third-party license claim; project-generated asset reproducible from the script.

generator.method: 16000 short low-alpha dabs along a dominant direction (22% crossing), density gated by three octaves of periodic patch noise, saturating pigment build-up, light grain; the normal is the wrapped central difference of the softened mask (DirectX green, Z reconstructed on the GPU).

intent: A dense, low-contrast dry-brush scumble rather than isolated strokes: the painterly shell shows it only along silhouettes, dithered per layer, so eight stacked shells read as a soft brushed halo.
